cards.note: Every plan includes guided onboarding and support for your team. Each plan includes everything in the one before it.

studio.name: Studio
studio.tagline: The complete foundation for running your location day to day.

features.0: Front desk POS with cash & card payments on-site

club.name: Club
club.tagline: Everything in Studio, plus the tools that keep your members engaged and coming back.

features.0: Branded member portal: members book, pay and manage their membership
features.2: Online booking, plus online & recurring payments
features.3: Access control: QR check-in with turnstile & door integration

studio.headline: You're running one location and need to replace the spreadsheets.
studio.body: Your operation is straightforward but your tools aren't keeping up. You need member management, class scheduling, billing at the front desk, and a system that actually works. Studio gives you everything to run your business properly from day one.

club.headline: You want members who book, pay and keep coming back on their own.
club.body: You're past the basics. You want members booking their own classes, managing their own memberships, and walking straight through the turnstile instead of queuing at reception. You also want to know when someone starts drifting away, before they cancel. Club adds the member portal, your own branded app, access control and retention tools, so your business is always one tap away.

core.headline: You're running more than one location, or want decisions based on data, not gut feeling.
core.body: You're running a serious operation and need the intelligence and control to match. Core brings all your locations into one account and adds AI-powered insights, your own automations, and full control over roles and integrations. We also move your data across from your current system and give you a named contact for priority support.

timeline.title: From first conversation to fully live.
timeline.body: Every business is different. The timeline depends on your scope, your data, and your team, but the process is always the same.

meeting.title: Book a Meeting
meeting.body: Pick a time that suits you, or leave your number and we'll call you back. A short first conversation to understand your business, your members and what you need from the platform.

demo.title: Demo
demo.body: See the platform in action with your specific business type in mind. Ask every question. Understand exactly what you're getting before committing to anything.

contract.title: Contract and Setup
contract.body: Once you're ready, we handle the contract and begin configuring your account. Your membership plans, class structure, staff roles, and branding are set up before your first training session.

migration.title: Data Migration
migration.body: Moving from another system? We map your existing member data and migrate it across. Your member history, payment records, and account details are carried over cleanly so nothing gets lost in the transition. Included in Core, available as an add-on for Studio and Club.

onboarding.title: Onboarding Call
onboarding.body: A dedicated session with your team where we walk through the platform, align on your goals, and make sure every staff member knows exactly what they are doing before go-live. Your knowledge base is available from this point so your team can always find answers independently.

live.title: Go Live
live.body: Your platform goes live with real members, real data, and support on standby. Email, chat, and phone support are available from day one so nothing gets dropped at launch.

cta.body: Book a guided demo with our team, or leave your number and we'll call you back.
